surface: src/plate_core/health.py + gh plate health CLI output
summary: `gh plate health` compares the checkout's `.github/labels.yml` registry to live GitHub labels (case-insensitive), reports a missing count and `gh plate bootstrap --apply` fix command, and never prints Label coverage OK when registry labels are absent (#1260).
migration_impact: Health may report MISSING where only the legacy eight type labels were checked before; run `gh plate bootstrap --apply` (or sync from `.github/labels.yml`) to create missing labels.
migration_guidance: When health lists missing labels, run `gh plate bootstrap --apply` from the repo checkout with an up-to-date `.github/labels.yml`.
Adopters on conservative import should refresh labels.yml manually before bootstrap if taxonomy drifted.
agent_notes: Reuses github_labels.fetch_repository_labels for pagination; bootstrap --apply already syncs the full registry.
